title: Anchorage: Kenai Fjords & Denali National Park 5 Day 4 Night Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Experience the wonder of Alaska over 5 days and 4 nights. See tidewater glaciers, whales, and other ocean wildlife! Visit Denali National Park to possibly see bears, wolves, and moose.

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS
~Alaska Pioneer Mine Experience
~Tidewater Glaciers & Wildlife of Kenai Fjords National Park
~Wildlife of Denali such as grizzly bears, caribou, dall sheep, moose & more
~Guests choose activities based on their interests
~Visit the Sled Dogs of Denali
